{{Quote|Who knows, maybe this will be just another milk run. By the red seas of Knores, we sure could use one to fill up the next several hours.|A smuggler discusses a business proposition with a partner|<ref name="Politics">{{WEGCite|story=Free Time|book=The Politics of Contraband}}</ref>}}
'''Knores''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] that was famous for its [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Ocean/Legends|seas]]. The world also featured a deep [[Equatorial trench (Knores)|equatorial trench]], appealing [[City/Legends|cities]], and violent weather. By [[3637 BBY]], the [[seismologist]] [[Fez Burba]] hypothesized that a [[Unidentified civilization (Knores)|civilization]] once existing on Knores had been rendered extinct due to shifts in Knores' crust. [[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] later, the world was ruled by the [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[House Viholn]].

==Description==
Knores was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Knores system/Legends|Knores system]] of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was linked via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Adoris system/Legends|Adoris]], [[Nars system/Legends|Nars]], and [[Senex system/Legends|Senex systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

The world's surface featured [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Ocean/Legends|seas]], for which it was famous,<ref name="TEA" /> and a deep [[Equatorial trench (Knores)|trench]] was located on Knores' equator.<ref name="SWTOR" /> Knores was a beautiful world, although its weather conditions were exceptionally violent.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
At some point around [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date SoR">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}} &mdash; According to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''{{'s}} lead designer, [[Charles Boyd]], the majority of the events of the digital expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']] take place in approximately [[3637 BBY]]. The Crew Skill mission "The Burba Assignment" is part of the ''Shadow of Revan'' expansion and therefore also takes place around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> the [[seismologist]] [[Fez Burba]] claimed that a [[Unidentified civilization (Knores)|civilization]] that had once existed on Knores had gone extinct due to shifts of the world's crust. In response,<ref name="SWTOR" /> the future [[Alliance Commander|commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]]<ref name="Commander">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=3}} establishes that [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]]&mdash;who becomes the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the future [[Eternal Alliance]] in "Chapter IX: The Alliance"&mdash;also was the player-controlled character in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''.</ref> sent a companion to Knores. The companion then traveled into the world's equatorial trench in order to confirm the hypothesis advanced by Burba.<ref name="SWTOR" />
{{Endgame}}

At some point between [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] adventures published in ''[[The Politics of Contraband]]'', including "[[Free Time]]," are set in the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and the events of ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the former to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], and ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' sets the latter in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].</ref> the [[Zarian]] [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Woetar]] offered a business proposition to a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] duo on the planet [[Antiquity]]. One of the smugglers then mentioned the seas of Knores to the other while expressing the need to accept the Zarian's proposal in order to stave off boredom.<ref name="Politics" />

==Inhabitants==
The seismologist Fez Burba hypothesized by 3637 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] that a civilization that once existed on Knores had gone extinct due to that world's tectonic activity.<ref name="SWTOR" /> When the [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]] established themselves as the rulers of the Senex-Juvex region at some point following the [[Ruusan campaign|Battle of Ruusan]] of [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], Knores came to be controlled by [[House Viholn]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Locations==
Knores featured handsome, safe, and logically constructed [[City/Legends|cities]] that were architecturally and culturally uninteresting.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Knores was introduced in "[[Free Time]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure written by [[Gary Haynes]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and published in the [[1992]] supplement ''[[The Politics of Contraband]]''.<ref name="Politics" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the world in grid square L-17.<ref name="TEA" />
